story_text: As a user, I want to create a task with a title so that I can track my work.

positive.title: Create task with a valid title
steps: 1. Send POST request to /tasks with a valid title in the request body.
2. Verify the response status code is 201 Created.
3. Verify the response body contains the task ID, title, and creation timestamp.
positive.expected_result: 201 Created · response body contains task ID, title, and creation timestamp

positive.title: Create task and verify it persists in the database
steps: 1. Send POST request to /tasks with a valid title in the request body.
2. Verify the response status code is 201 Created.
3. Send GET request to /tasks/{task_id} to retrieve the created task.
4. Verify the retrieved task contains the correct title and creation timestamp.
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · returned task matches submitted title exactly

negative.title: Attempt to create task without a title
steps: 1. Send POST request to /tasks without a title in the request body.
2. Verify the response status code is 400 Bad Request.
3. Verify the response body contains an error message indicating that the title is required.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request with error message indicating title is required

negative.title: Create task without authentication
steps: 1. Send POST request to /tasks with a valid title in the request body.
2. Verify the response status code is 401 Unauthorized.

edge.title: Create task with a title containing leading/trailing whitespace
steps: 1. Send POST request to /tasks with a title that has leading and trailing whitespace in the request body.
2. Verify the response status code is 201 Created.
3. Verify the response body contains the task ID and title, and check how the title is stored (trimmed or as-is).
edge.expected_result: 201 Created · title trimmed or stored as-is per defined behaviour — must be consistent

edge.title: Create task with a title containing Unicode characters
steps: 1. Send POST request to /tasks with a title that includes Unicode characters (e.g., emojis, non-Latin scripts) in the request body.
2. Verify the response status code is 201 Created.
3. Verify the response body contains the task ID and title, and check that the Unicode characters are stored and returned correctly.
edge.expected_result: 201 Created · UTF-8 characters stored and returned correctly

edge.title: Verify response schema on task creation
steps: 1. Send POST request to /tasks with a valid title in the request body.
2. Verify the response status code is 201 Created.
3. Verify the response body contains the expected fields (id, title, createdAt, status) and that the Content-Type header is set to application/json.
edge.expected_result: Response includes id, title, createdAt, status fields · Content-Type: application/json
